pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth edge gradients and high contrast against the light interstitial network. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous across the visible flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Contiguous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway width is largely uniform across the observed central region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible jagged silhouette along the superior neck line, characterized by a high-frequency sequence of low-amplitude peaks.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small dark silhouette with a pointed anterior profile perched on the upper dorsal ridge.
